item.title: Ledger asks resellers to halt sales in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong
item.description: The wallet maker requested that devices be removed from shelves while investigators work to establish where tampering occurred.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Most tokenized stock trading on Solana, BNB Chain occurs outside US market hours
item.description: Tokenized equities have reached nearly $3.3 billion in value as investors embrace round-the-clock access beyond Wall Street hours.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Trezor reduces resellers as a ‘preventative step’ amid Ledger tampering reports
item.description: CCO Danny Sanders said he had notified certain hardware wallet resellers that they would be removed from Trezor’s list of authorized entities starting Jan. 1.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: How the SEC’s lack of leadership could facilitate crypto rulemaking
item.description: A recent change in the SEC’s rules on quorum could make it easier for the agency to amend its approach to crypto regulation in the absence of a market structure bill.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Strive reports $208M in warrant exercises as Bitcoin holdings jump 11%
item.description: Strive is now the fifth-largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin holder, with 32,773 BTC, as it continues to expand its treasury through equity financing.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Bitcoin keeps up pressure on $84K as US stocks skirt Korea tech sell-off
item.description: Bitcoin price action preserved overnight gains as US stocks quickly rebounded after opening lower on the back of Korea’s tech-stock rout.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Anthropic warns ‘AI worms’ may autonomously spread across devices like a virus
item.description: Anthropic warned that rogue “AI worms” are months away from the ability to self-replicate and autonomously infect user devices such as home appliances and other internet-connected devices.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Is Bitcoin kidding itself about the Lightning Network?
item.description: Bitcoin developer Paul Sztorc says Bitcoiners are lying to themselves about Lightning. Developers claim usability has improved, but questions remain over everyday adoption.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: Digital cash offers ‘cash-like privacy,’ but bank data breaches threaten users: BIS
item.description: BIS said that digital cash can achieve “cash-like privacy,” however, the technology isn’t yet production-ready due to risks such as bank data breaches.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Russia clears Sberbank for crypto trading ahead of December launch
item.description: Russia’s largest bank, Sberbank, has secured crypto exchange authorization as it prepares to offer Bitcoin, Ether and Tether USDt trading.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: ENS seeks DAO approval to activate upgraded Ethereum naming system
item.description: New .eth registrations would pause for hours during the transition, while existing domain holders could renew their names without migrating.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Metaplanet to issue $329M convertible bonds to pay debt, fund share buybacks
item.description: Metaplanet plans to issue zero-interest bonds with a five-year maturity to improve its debt structure and cut its reliance on Bitcoin-collateralized loans without selling holdings.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: MediaMarktSaturn pulls Ledger products amid tampering reports
item.description: European retailer MediaMarkt pulled Ledger products as the wallet maker probes tampering reports beyond CryptoBilis in Southeast Asia.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Bitcoin hits $84K resistance as Korean tech rout deepens KOSPI losses
item.description: Bitcoin’s liquidity kept BTC price below $84,000 amid a mounting South Korean tech and semiconductor stock sell-off.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Chinese fraud victims lose key court battle over 61,000 Bitcoin
item.description: Chinese fraud victims seeking to recover 61,000 seized Bitcoin face a legal setback after a UK court ruled that Chinese law governs their claims.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Ledger details LTE-enabled spy implants in wallets sold by CryptoBilis
item.description: Ledger detailed how LTE-enabled implants exposed wallet recovery phrases as CryptoBilis halted sales and Trezor and OneKey cut ties with the reseller.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Blur is shutting down its website, so why are NFT collectors cheering?
item.description: Blur’s planned website closure revived criticism of the royalty policies and token rewards that helped it overtake OpenSea during the NFT boom, but hurt creators.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Binance to shut down crypto mining pool services in November
item.description: Binance will discontinue its mining pool and related services on Nov. 10, urging miners to move to alternative pools before the shutdown.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: South Korea moves to block 27 crypto websites, including KuCoin, MEXC
item.description: Authorities said the restrictions are aimed at unregistered exchanges and have acknowledged that customers could have difficulty withdrawing assets.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Meta claims new Muse Wonder AI models rival OpenAI, Anthropic
item.description: Meta co-founder Mark Zuckerberg said its newest models are a step toward “personal superintelligence.”
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Aptos rolls out Encrypted Mempool to curb frontrunning, sandwich attacks
item.description: The optional feature hides transaction details until their order is finalized, preventing bots from exploiting pending trades.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: FTX’s crypto mining venture is now used to advance AI
item.description: The defunct exchange acquired a 20% stake in Genesis Digital Assets before FTX declared bankruptcy in November 2022.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Crypto PACs report $2.7M spending blitz on House races as midterms loom
item.description: With just 22 days until the US midterm elections, a crypto-aligned committee has announced another major ad expenditure to support “pro-crypto” candidates in 2026.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: US accounting overhaul could make stablecoins more attractive to corporations: Tempo
item.description: A Tempo report examines how proposed US accounting rules could change corporate stablecoin holdings, with direct redemption rights determining which tokens qualify as cash.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Bitcoin miners face widening AI financing costs as lenders scrutinize deals
item.description: The Bitcoin mining industry needs roughly $50 billion to complete planned AI infrastructure projects, with IREN, Riot Platforms and HIVE Digital facing major funding gaps.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Bitcoin drops 2.2% as Ukraine, Iran strikes send oil toward one-month high
item.description: Bitcoin price action stayed rangebound after failing to sustain above $84,000 into the Wall Street open on rising oil prices.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: XRP treasury Evernorth’s shares rise 5% at Nasdaq opening print
item.description: Evernorth’s share price rose by 5% as investors welcomed the Nasdaq debut of the first pure-play XRP digital asset treasury.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Ledger implant tests Bitcoin ETFs as safer custodial solutions than hardware wallets
item.description: The discovery of an unauthorized Ledger hardware implant reignited debate on whether Bitcoin ETFs are safer than self-custodying Bitcoin via hardware wallet devices.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Strategy adds 250 Bitcoin as holdings reach 848,250 BTC
item.description: Michael Saylor’s Strategy said Bitcoin holdings reached 848,250 BTC after its latest purchase, while maintaining a $4.88 billion cash reserve.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
